A few implementation details from local validation that may help scope this:

Current behavior in `opencode web`:
- The app already bundles KaTeX and uses `marked-katex-extension` for markdown rendering.
- However, the renderer currently handles `$...$` and `$$...$$`, but not `\(...\)` and `\[...\]`.
- In practice, models often emit the escaped LaTeX delimiters, so users see raw math like `\(\rho\)` and `\[ ... \]` instead of rendered equations.

Concrete repro in `opencode web`:
```md
A quantum state \( \rho \) gives an observable expectation by

\[
\langle O \rangle = \mathrm{Tr}(O\rho)
\]
```

Observed result:
- `\( \rho \)` and `\[ ... \]` render as plain text.

Relevant code paths:
- `packages/ui/src/context/marked.tsx`
  - already uses `marked-katex-extension`
- `packages/ui/src/styles/index.css`
  - already imports `katex/dist/katex.min.css`

So this looks less like “add a renderer from scratch” and more like “normalize/accept the standard escaped LaTeX delimiters before markdown parsing”.

Minimal implementation direction:
- Normalize `\(...\)` -> `$...$`
- Normalize `\[...\]` -> `$$...$$`
- Do that before markdown parsing, while skipping inline code / fenced code blocks so code samples are not mutated.

One extra note: the public share page renderer is a separate code path from the main app UI, so if this gets fixed in `opencode web`, it is worth checking whether the share page should be kept in sync too.

This issue might be a duplicate of existing issues. Please check:
- #23622: Same root cause — `sdkKey()` in `transform.ts` falls back to `model.providerID` instead of the underlying SDK's expected key, causing `providerOptions` to be silently dropped. That issue tracks the same bug for providers with dotted names; this issue describes the same pattern for `ai-gateway-provider`.
- #21632: Related — model variants configured on subagents are parsed but not applied at runtime, which overlaps with the `variants()` switch missing the `ai-gateway-provider` case described here.

If your issue is distinct (e.g. the fix for #23622 didn't cover `ai-gateway-provider`), please clarify so maintainers can track it separately.

Scope note: this only affects cf-ai-gateway models whose underlying SDK is `ai-gateway-provider` (i.e. OpenAI / openai-compatible upstreams). Anthropic and Google models on cf-ai-gateway resolve to bundled `@ai-sdk/anthropic` / `@ai-sdk/google` per `models.dev`, so `sdkKey()` returns the right key for those and `providerOptions` / `variants` route correctly. The fix is specifically for the `ai-gateway-provider` codepath.

I fixed it by just delete the folder `~\.cache\opencode\packages` and restart opencode

Deleting `~/.cache/opencode/packages` works, but only until the next restart — the same ENOENT comes back.

The root cause is in `Npm.add()`: on cache hit it uses `npa(pkg).name` to reconstruct the path, but for `github:` specifiers `npa()` returns `name: null`, falling back to the raw spec string as the directory name (e.g. `node_modules/github:Edison-A-N/...`), which doesn't exist. First install works fine because `reify()` + `tree.edgesOut` resolves the correct name; cache hit skips reify and gets it wrong.
